credit_line: Gift of The Contemporary Museum, Honolulu, 2011, and gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation (TCM.2004.22)
description: A twisting, ribbon-like black band runs through the center of the composition. The band splits into two forks, like two parts of a river diverging. The forms contrast with the plain white surface of the exposed paper surrounding it.
